thesis: The homepage's single external 'Learn more' link to iana.org is the most valuable conversion mechanism on this site, but it bleeds value by terminating the funnel with no internal next step, no value proposition, and no trust signals, causing visitors to leave without any path to conversion.

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.summary: 6 of 6 standard security headers are absent, which weakens protection against XSS, clickjacking and downgrade attacks.
findings.problem: 6 of 6 standard security headers are absent, which weakens protection against XSS, clickjacking and downgrade attacks.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Add the missing headers at the CDN or web-server layer; HSTS and X-Content-Type-Options are one-line changes.
findings.evidence: Measured on the live origin: missing HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Single-step funnel dead end
findings.summary: The page offers only one call to action that exits the site, leaving no defined next step in a conversion path.
findings.problem: The page offers only one call to action that exits the site, leaving no defined next step in a conversion path.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Example Domain; cta: Sign up or Explore products; notes: Add internal primary CTA and ensure Learn more leads to a page with next step
findings.evidence: The only call to action on the page is “Learn more”. | Page copy reads “# Example Domain This domain is for use in documentation examples without needing permission. Avoid use in operations. [Learn more](https://iana.org/domains/example)”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: External link funnel dead end
findings.summary: The only call to action navigates away from the domain to iana.org, terminating the conversion path without any return or continuation option.
findings.problem: The only call to action navigates away from the domain to iana.org, terminating the conversion path without any return or continuation option.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Example Domain; cta: Learn more (opens in new tab) or internal CTA; notes: Replace or supplement external link with internal destination or open in new tab with visible path back
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: No value proposition
findings.summary: The page copy only describes the domain's purpose for documentation examples and provides no statement of what is sold or why it is better for a visitor.
findings.problem: The page copy only describes the domain's purpose for documentation examples and provides no statement of what is sold or why it is better for a visitor.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Clear value proposition; cta: Benefit-oriented CTA; notes: Replace placeholder copy with clear value proposition naming product/service and primary benefit
findings.evidence: This domain is for use in documentation examples without needing permission. | Avoid use in operations.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: No competing CTAs
findings.summary: The page has exactly one call to action, so there is no ambiguity from competing options, but this also means the funnel has no alternative entry points.
findings.problem: The page has exactly one call to action, so there is no ambiguity from competing options, but this also means the funnel has no alternative entry points.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Example Domain; cta: Learn more + secondary CTA (e.g., Contact); notes: Introduce secondary, lower-priority CTA to give choice without overwhelming
findings.evidence: The only call to action on the page is “Learn more”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Weak page metadata
findings.summary: Search and social previews are degraded: page title (absent), meta description, Open Graph tags are missing or outside recommended lengths.
findings.problem: Search and social previews are degraded: page title (absent), meta description, Open Graph tags are missing or outside recommended lengths.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Write a 15-60 char title and 70-160 char description per page; add og:title and og:image for link previews.
findings.evidence: Measured on the homepage: title 0 chars (15-60 recommended); description 0 chars (70-160 recommended); og:title missing, og:image missing.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Missing trust signals above the fold
findings.summary: The homepage shows no sign of returns policy, guarantee, reviews, security badge, so a first-time visitor has nothing to offset purchase risk.
findings.problem: The homepage shows no sign of returns policy, guarantee, reviews, security badge, so a first-time visitor has nothing to offset purchase risk.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Surface review counts, the returns window and a guarantee near the primary call to action.
findings.evidence: Measured on the live homepage: no match for returns policy, guarantee, reviews, security badge.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: No responsive viewport
findings.summary: Without a viewport meta tag, mobile browsers render the desktop layout scaled down, making every tap target too small.
findings.problem: Without a viewport meta tag, mobile browsers render the desktop layout scaled down, making every tap target too small.
findings.evidence: Measured on the mobile render: no <meta name="viewport"> present.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift

findings.title: Missing trust signals

findings.problem: The homepage shows no sign of returns policy, guarantee, reviews, security badge, so a first-time visitor has nothing to offset purchase risk.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Surface review counts, the returns window and a guarantee near the primary call to action.

findings.title: Generic CTA label
findings.summary: The only call to action is 'Learn more,' which does not communicate the offer or next step in a way that clarifies what the visitor would get.
findings.problem: The only call to action is 'Learn more,' which does not communicate the offer or next step in a way that clarifies what the visitor would get.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Example Domain; cta: Action-specific, benefit-oriented label; notes: Change CTA to tell visitor exactly what they will receive or do next
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift
